label: cbexport
type: the command-line tool for bulk-exporting documents from a Couchbase Server bucket/collection to a JSON or CSV file. Sibling of tool:cbimport. NOT the same as Capella's own Data API / UI export surface (cloud/clusters/data-service/export.md) - this is a Server CLI tool; no source page states the two are the same mechanism.
aliases_note: Folds a pre-existing three-way fork, older than round 19's same-round forks and only surfaced now that this tool's own reference pages were finally read: `tool:cbexport` (Capella's command-line-tools.json plus this round's two server pages), `server:cbexport` (cloud/connect/cli-import-export.json), and `capella:cbexport` (cloud/clusters/data-service/export.json). Verified before folding, not assumed: export.json's own relation is a direct `seeAlso` to the server tool's reference page ('The cbexport json command-line tool exports data from Capella to JSON format'), confirming all three spellings name the identical CLI tool rather than Capella's separate UI/REST export surface. 6 distinct files combined.
evidence: Operations (commands or sub-commands) which connect to a cluster are not supported during major cluster configuration changes.
The lines format specifies a file that contains one JSON document on every line in the file. This format is specified by setting the --format option to "lines".
The list format specifies a file which contains a JSON list where each element in the list is a JSON document.
relates_to_competency_question: Is there a CLI tool for bulk-exporting documents from Couchbase Server directly, separate from any UI or REST export surface?
